# BoardSim

> BoardSim is a board-level executive cybersecurity decision simulator. A visitor
> takes the role of an executive facing a four-stage incident: they choose one of
> three options at each stage, substantiate a board pack, and receive a score
> computed on the server from a published rule set, with a rule-by-rule trace, a
> replay of the recorded decisions and a separate regulatory assessment.

Canonical: https://boardsim.iliadis.net/
Author: Dr. John Iliadis — https://www.iliadis.net/
Language: English (en)
Licence of the interface: free to use, no account, no cost.

## What the product is

- A decision exercise, not a course, a certification or a scanner.
- Four stages, three authored options per stage, ten weighted dimensions of
  judgement (strategic, risk, regulatory, and seven more).
- A deterministic integer score from 0 to 100. The same decisions always produce
  the same score: no randomness, no language model, no inference.
- Every score is reproducible from the pinned SHA-256 hashes of the scoring
  policy, the regulatory bundle and the scenario content that the run recorded.

## How the score is computed

Each dimension starts at 70; the rules that fire add or subtract authored deltas;
the risk-appetite setting adds published modifiers to four rules only; each
dimension is clipped to 0–100; the weighted sum is divided by 100 and floored.
The formula, the current weights, the appetite modifiers and the score bands are
rendered live at https://boardsim.iliadis.net/#/methodology from the same policy
the engine uses.

## What it is not

- Not a psychometric instrument: the weights and deltas are authored judgement and
  have not been calibrated or validated.
- Not legal advice: the regulatory panel is a separate applicability assessment
  derived from authored facts, and instruments that require counsel say so.
- Not a compliance certification. A score reflects agreement with the published
  BoardSim policy for that scenario, nothing wider.

## Machine-readable endpoints

All are same-origin JSON, GET unless stated, and are the canonical way to read
this product's content without executing JavaScript.

- https://boardsim.iliadis.net/v1/health — release, pins, schema and store status.
- https://boardsim.iliadis.net/v1/methodology — the health payload plus the
  methodology note.
- https://boardsim.iliadis.net/v1/scenarios — the fourteen scenarios: title,
  sector, difficulty, stage and option structure.
- https://boardsim.iliadis.net/v1/glossary — 10 dimensions with weights, 47
  decision rules with rationale and NIST CSF 2.0 function, 28 regulatory
  instruments with official sources, and the appetite/band/difficulty settings.
- https://boardsim.iliadis.net/v1/demo — the demo run (no stored state).
  POST /v1/demo/decide chooses a stage option in the demo.
- POST https://boardsim.iliadis.net/v1/runs — create a run; then
  POST /v1/runs/{id}/decisions, POST /v1/runs/{id}/board and POST
  /v1/runs/{id}/score.
- GET https://boardsim.iliadis.net/v1/runs/{id}/explain — the full explanation:
  score, dimensions, contributions, rule trace, authored consequences per
  decision, regulatory panel, governance flags and the verification chain.
- POST https://boardsim.iliadis.net/v1/shares — mint a read-only result link;
  GET /v1/shares/{token} reads it, DELETE revokes it.

Writes are rate limited per client (10 run creations, 30 decisions, 10 shares and
120 reads per minute); a refused write answers 429 with `Retry-After`.

- https://boardsim.iliadis.net/ — the simulator.
- https://boardsim.iliadis.net/#/scenarios — the fourteen scenarios.

- https://boardsim.iliadis.net/#/about — provenance, limitations, author.
